Our Experience

We Build Products. We Don't Just Write Code.

Snehix Blackboard

Snehix has designed and developed a complete ePaper-based product platform that combines purpose-built hardware, embedded software, cloud connectivity, Android/web applications and AI-enabled handwritten-content workflows. The platform is designed to make handwritten information digital, connected and useful across devices.

This end-to-end experience in building hardware, embedded software, cloud platforms and AI-driven features gives us a practical understanding of the engineering challenges our customers face.
